name: How long does it take to install new cabinet pulls on an average kitchen?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install new cabinet pulls on an average kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for new cabinet pulls depends on the number of cabinets and the complexity of the pull design. For an average kitchen with 20-30 pulls, a professional installation can typically be completed within 3-5 hours. This includes careful measurement, drilling, and secure attachment of each pull. If existing holes need to be filled or new drilling templates are required, the time may extend slightly. We aim for efficient, precise work to minimize disruption to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installing new cabinet pulls on an average kitchen (20-30 pulls) typically takes 3-5 hours for a professional. This includes precise measurement and drilling.
